title: ProactGen: Learning Proactive Clarification for Video Generation
title_zh: ProactGen：面向视频生成的主动澄清学习

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation let users create high-quality videos from natural language descriptions, yet obtaining results that match user intent remains time-consuming: individual generations are computationally expensive, and underspecified prompts force repeated cycles of generation, inspection, and revision. Existing video prompt optimization methods improve generation through automatic rewriting, but cannot supply the ideas and preferences that were not in the initial description. We propose ProactGen, a video generation framework that learns proactive clarification, eliciting user intent through questions grounded in generated video drafts. Specifically, we train a vision-language model as a questioning policy with reinforcement learning: observing the initial prompt and a video draft, it learns to ask the questions most valuable to downstream generation, rewarded by the alignment between the final generated video and a target reference. We further find that effective questioning does not require drafts of final-output quality, and exploit this property by generating drafts with fewer denoising steps, keeping the added cost of clarification low. Experiments show that ProactGen improves target alignment over direct generation by at least 1.8 × 1.8\times the gain of the strongest baselines. Moreover, a single round of ProactGen already exceeds the alignment that the strongest baseline reaches after four refinement rounds, in 29% of its time.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成的最新进展让用户能够通过自然语言描述创建高质量视频，但获得符合用户意图的结果仍然耗时：单次生成在计算上代价高昂，而不充分的具体化的提示词迫使用户反复进行生成、检查和修改的循环。 现有的视频提示词优化方法通过自动改写来改进生成效果，但无法提供初始描述中不曾包含的想法和偏好。 我们提出 ProactGen，一个学习主动澄清的视频生成框架，通过基于生成的视频草稿所提出的问题来引出用户意图。 具体而言，我们通过强化学习将一个视觉语言模型训练为提问策略：在观察初始提示词和视频草稿后，它学会提出对下游生成最有价值的问题，并以最终生成的视频与目标参考视频之间的对齐程度作为奖励。 我们进一步发现，有效的提问并不需要达到最终输出质量的草稿，并利用这一特性通过更少的去噪步数来生成草稿，从而将澄清带来的额外开销保持在较低水平。 实验表明，ProactGen 在目标对齐方面相比直接生成至少提升 1.8 × 1.8\times，达到最强基线方法收益的 1.8\times 倍。 此外，单轮 ProactGen 就已超越最强基线经过四轮优化后达到的对齐水平，而仅花费其 29% 的时间。

paragraphs.en: Rapid progress in video generation has enabled ordinary users to create high-quality videos from a single natural language description ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Turning that description into a video that matches what the user had in mind, however, remains time-consuming, for two compounding reasons. First, video generation is expensive: every full generation runs tens of denoising steps over a spatiotemporal latent space and costs substantial computation and waiting time. Second, users rarely manage to specify everything they want in the initial prompt. Details such as the subject’s appearance, the manner of an action, the lighting, or the camera motion are often recognized as missing or misinterpreted only after the user sees the result ( Hutchinson et al., 2022 ; Hahn et al., 2024 ) . Together, these difficulties force users through repeated cycles of generation, inspection, and revision, each paid for with a costly full generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成领域的快速进展使普通用户能够仅凭一段自然语言描述就创作出高质量视频（Wan et al., 2025；Kong et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025）。 然而，要把该描述变成符合用户心中所想的视频，仍然十分耗时，原因有两点且相互叠加。 其一，视频生成的代价高昂：每次完整生成都要在时空潜空间上运行数十个去噪步骤，消耗大量算力与等待时间。 其二，用户很少能在初始提示词中把想要的一切都描述清楚。 诸如主体的外观、动作的方式、光照或镜头运动等细节，往往要等用户看到生成结果后才发现有遗漏或被误解（Hutchinson et al., 2022；Hahn et al., 2024）。 这些困难叠加在一起，迫使用户反复经历生成、检查与修改的循环，而每一次都要付出一次昂贵的完整生成的代价。

paragraphs.en: Existing work addresses this problem mainly by rewriting the prompt. Video prompt optimization methods ( Gao et al., 2025a ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) use language models to expand or rewrite the initial prompt into a form the generator handles well, and some further refine the rewrite with feedback from generated videos ( Gao et al., 2025b ; Long et al., 2026 ) . These methods improve how the available information is expressed, but cannot supply the ideas and preferences that were never in the initial description: the generator has no way of knowing what color the user pictured for the subject or whether the camera should push in or orbit, and a rewrite can only substitute a guess. A second line of work lets the system interact with the user: in image generation, users express preferences through editing instructions or by choosing among candidates ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Nabati et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , or the system proactively asks clarifying questions ( Hahn et al., 2024 ) derived from a belief state parsed from the prompt; in language modeling, clarification questions have been trained with the quality of the eventual answer as the signal ( Andukuri et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . These results show that interaction can recover intent that rewriting cannot, and that which question to ask can be learned from what happens afterwards. In these settings, however, questions are selected from the text of the request or a belief state parsed from it, and learning, where present, is supervised by a text response or by the user’s choice among candidates. How to choose questions from what a video generator actually produces for a given prompt, and to learn that choice from the final video, remains open; to our knowledge, proactive clarification has not been studied in video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作主要通过重写提示词来解决这一问题。 视频提示词优化方法（Gao et al., 2025a; Cheng et al., 2025; Ji et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026a）使用语言模型将初始提示词扩展或重写为生成器易于处理的形式，一些方法还利用生成视频的反馈进一步改进重写结果（Gao et al., 2025b; Long et al., 2026）。 这些方法改进了已有信息的表达方式，但无法补充初始描述中从未包含的想法和偏好：生成器无从得知用户为拍摄主体设想的是什么颜色，也不知道镜头应该推近还是环绕，重写只能用一个猜测来替代。 第二类工作让系统与用户交互：在图像生成中，用户通过编辑指令或在候选结果中选择来表达偏好（Wang et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2025; Nabati et al., 2024; Li et al., 2026），或者系统基于从提示词解析出的信念状态主动提出澄清性问题（Hahn et al., 2024）；在语言建模中，澄清性问题的训练以最终回答的质量作为信号（Andukuri et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025）。 这些结果表明，交互能够恢复重写无法恢复的意图，并且提什么问题可以从后续发生的事情中学习得到。 然而，在这些场景中，问题是从请求文本或从中解析出的信念状态中选取的，而学习（如果存在的话）则由文本回复或用户在候选结果中的选择来监督。 如何根据视频生成器针对给定提示词实际生成的内容来选取问题，并从最终视频中学习这一选择，仍然悬而未决；据我们所知，主动澄清在视频生成领域尚未被研究过。

paragraphs.en: We propose ProactGen, a video generation framework that learns proactive clarification: its questions are grounded in a generated draft, and what to ask is learned from the final generation outcome. Given the initial prompt, the generator first produces a video draft; a questioning policy observes both the prompt and the draft and asks a small number of scoped questions; the user’s answers are merged into a refined prompt, from which the generator produces the final video. The policy is trained with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , rewarding the alignment between the final video and a target reference, so it learns to read the defaults and uncertainties the draft exposes and to ask for the information that matters most to downstream generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ProactGen，一个学习主动澄清的视频生成框架：其提问基于生成的草稿，而问什么则从最终生成结果中学习。 给定初始提示，生成器先生成一段视频草稿；提问策略同时观察提示和草稿，并提出少量范围明确的问题；用户的回答被合并进精炼后的提示，生成器据此生成最终视频。 该策略使用 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）训练，以最终视频与目标参考之间的对齐程度作为奖励，从而学会解读草稿所暴露的默认设定与不确定性，并询问对下游生成最重要的信息。

paragraphs.en: Questioning needs a draft, and a draft is itself a video generation; if clarification had to wait for a full-quality generation, its benefit to the user’s total time would be largely offset. We observe that effective questioning does not require a draft of final-output quality: questions depend on how the draft renders the subject, layout, action, and camera, and diffusion models settle these aspects early in denoising, with later steps mainly refining texture and detail ( Balaji et al., 2022 ) . ProactGen therefore generates drafts with a greatly reduced number of denoising steps and spends the full budget only on the final video. What the draft gives up is the late-stage detail that questioning does not depend on, so clarification adds little beyond a low-cost draft to direct generation while the cues that questioning relies on are largely preserved.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ProactGen with a simulated user whose intent is given by a hidden reference video. On 500 samples from InstanceCap ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , ProactGen achieves higher target alignment than direct generation, representative video prompt optimization methods, and a proactive clarification method adapted to video on all three metrics, and its gain over direct generation is at least 1.8 × 1.8\times that of the strongest baselines. Ablations show that reinforcement learning brings a clear gain and that the benefit of observing the draft emerges only after training. Measured in time, one round of ProactGen, about 16 s, already exceeds the alignment reached by four rounds of automatic rewriting or 15 turns of proactive clarification, and further rounds add further gains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用一个模拟用户来评估 ProactGen，该用户的意图由一条隐藏的参考视频给出。 在来自 InstanceCap（Fan et al., 2025）的 500 个样本上，ProactGen 在全部三项指标上的目标对齐度均高于直接生成、代表性的视频提示词优化方法，以及一种适配视频的主动澄清方法，且其相对直接生成的提升至少是最强基线的 1.8 倍（1.8\times）。 消融实验表明，强化学习带来了明显增益，而观察草稿的收益只有在训练之后才会显现。 以时间衡量，ProactGen 的一轮（约 16 秒）已能达到四轮自动改写或 15 轮主动澄清所达到的对齐度，且更多轮次还能带来进一步提升。

sents.en: We evaluate ProactGen with a simulated user whose intent is given by a hidden reference video.
sents.zh: 我们用一个模拟用户来评估 ProactGen，该用户的意图由一条隐藏的参考视频给出。

sents.en: On 500 samples from InstanceCap ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , ProactGen achieves higher target alignment than direct generation, representative video prompt optimization methods, and a proactive clarification method adapted to video on all three metrics, and its gain over direct generation is at least 1.8 × 1.8\times that of the strongest baselines.
sents.zh: 在来自 InstanceCap（Fan et al., 2025）的 500 个样本上，ProactGen 在全部三项指标上的目标对齐度均高于直接生成、代表性的视频提示词优化方法，以及一种适配视频的主动澄清方法，且其相对直接生成的提升至少是最强基线的 1.8 倍（1.8\times）。

sents.en: Ablations show that reinforcement learning brings a clear gain and that the benefit of observing the draft emerges only after training.
sents.zh: 消融实验表明，强化学习带来了明显增益，而观察草稿的收益只有在训练之后才会显现。

sents.en: Measured in time, one round of ProactGen, about 16 s, already exceeds the alignment reached by four rounds of automatic rewriting or 15 turns of proactive clarification, and further rounds add further gains.
sents.zh: 以时间衡量，ProactGen 的一轮（约 16 秒）已能达到四轮自动改写或 15 轮主动澄清所达到的对齐度，且更多轮次还能带来进一步提升。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, ProactGen is the first to bring proactive clarification to video generation; we build a reproducible simulated-user protocol and compare with prompt optimization and proactive clarification baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，ProactGen 是首个将主动式澄清引入视频生成的工作；我们构建了可复现的模拟用户协议，并与提示词优化和主动式澄清基线方法进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: We propose a reinforcement learning framework in which the questioning policy learns, from the final generation outcome, what to ask about a generated draft, targeting the defaults the generator fills in on the sample at hand.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种强化学习框架，其中提问策略从最终生成结果中学习应就生成的草稿询问什么内容，目标是生成器在当前样本上填充的默认内容。

paragraphs.en: We find that effective questioning does not need final-quality drafts and use few-step drafts for clarification, which at equal time buys more alignment than rewriting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，有效的提问并不需要最终质量的草稿，因此采用少步数草稿进行澄清，这在相同时间内比改写能获得更多的一致性对齐。

paragraphs.en: One line of work improves generation by automatically rewriting the user’s prompt. In image generation, Promptist ( Hao et al., 2023 ) trains a rewriter with reinforcement learning using aesthetic and relevance scores of the generated images as reward, and RePrompt ( Wu et al., 2026 ) adds chain-of-thought reasoning supervised by multiple reward models. In video generation, RAPO ( Gao et al., 2025a ) retrieves modifiers from the training corpus and trains a branch selector, VPO ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) and Prompt-A-Video ( Ji et al., 2025 ) train rewriters from video-level preferences or reward-model signals, and SCMAPR ( Yang et al., 2026a ) runs a multi-agent pipeline of scenario routing, rewriting, and text-level semantic verification. Recent methods further refine the prompt at inference with feedback from generated videos: RAPO++ ( Gao et al., 2025b ) inspects the output with a vision-language model and corrects the prompt, and VISTA ( Long et al., 2026 ) self-improves through a loop of multi-agent critique. Whether or not they look at generated output, the input of these methods is limited to what the user already wrote, and for preferences absent from the prompt they can only fall back on the model’s prior. ProactGen is complementary: its learned action acquires the missing information from the user.
paragraphs.zh: 一类工作通过自动改写用户的提示词来提升生成效果。 在图像生成方面，Promptist（Hao et al., 2023）利用生成图像的美学评分和相关性评分作为奖励，通过强化学习训练一个改写器；RePrompt（Wu et al., 2026）则在多个奖励模型的监督下引入思维链推理。 在视频生成方面，RAPO（Gao et al., 2025a）从训练语料中检索修饰词并训练一个分支选择器，VPO（Cheng et al., 2025）和 Prompt-A-Video（Ji et al., 2025）基于视频级偏好或奖励模型信号训练改写器，SCMAPR（Yang et al., 2026a）则运行一个由场景路由、改写和文本级语义校验组成的多智能体流水线。 近期的方法进一步利用生成视频的反馈在推理阶段对提示词进行精炼：RAPO++（Gao et al., 2025b）用视觉语言模型检查输出并修正提示词，VISTA（Long et al., 2026）则通过多智能体批判的循环进行自我改进。 无论是否查看生成结果，这些方法的输入都仅限于用户已经写下的内容，对于提示词中缺失的偏好，它们只能依赖模型的先验。 ProactGen 与之互补：其学习到的动作可以从用户那里获取缺失的信息。

paragraphs.en: A second line of work lets the system interact with the user to obtain intent. In language modeling, clarification questions have been trained with the quality of the downstream answer as the signal ( Andukuri et al., 2024 ; Dou & Liu, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , or ambiguity has been detected from disagreement among generated code solutions ( Mu et al., 2023 ) , with text as the downstream product. In image generation, Proactive T2I ( Hahn et al., 2024 ) has a language model parse entities, attributes, and relations from the prompt into a belief graph, selects uncertain and important elements to ask the user about, and proposes an automatic evaluation protocol with a simulated user driven by a reference image; its questioning policies are heuristic or prompted. PASTA ( Nabati et al., 2024 ) learns with offline reinforcement learning which set of candidate prompts to present to the user, APPO ( Li et al., 2026 ) lets the user choose among rendered candidates and optimizes the prompt accordingly, and DiffChat ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and DialogGen ( Huang et al., 2025 ) revise prompts from user editing instructions or hold multi-turn dialogue. In the video domain, IC-Seg ( Yang et al., 2026b ) uses hierarchical GRPO to learn when and how to clarify in referring segmentation. In ProactGen, questions are grounded in a video draft the generator produced for the sample at hand, and question selection is learned with the alignment of the final generated video to the target as the reward.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线让系统与用户交互以获取意图。 在语言建模中，澄清问题的训练以下游回答的质量作为信号（Andukuri et al., 2024；Dou & Liu, 2026；Zhang et al., 2025），或者从生成的代码解决方案之间的分歧中检测歧义（Mu et al., 2023），其下游产品为文本。 在图像生成中，Proactive T2I（Hahn et al., 2024）让语言模型从提示中解析实体、属性和关系并构建信念图，选出不确定且重要的元素向用户提问，并提出一种由参考图像驱动的模拟用户参与的自动评估协议；其提问策略是启发式的或由提示驱动的。 PASTA（Nabati et al., 2024）通过离线强化学习来决定向用户展示哪组候选提示，APPO（Li et al., 2026）让用户在渲染出的候选项中进行选择并据此优化提示，而 DiffChat（Wang et al., 2024）和 DialogGen（Huang et al., 2025）则根据用户的编辑指令修改提示或进行多轮对话。 在视频领域，IC-Seg（Yang et al., 2026b）使用分层 GRPO 来学习何时以及如何进行澄清式提问，用于指代分割任务。 在 ProactGen 中，问题以生成器为当前样本生成的视频草稿为依据，问题选择的学习则以最终生成的视频与目标的契合度作为奖励。

paragraphs.en: ProactGen lets the system proactively obtain, within a single generation pipeline, the information missing from the user’s initial prompt, so that the final video comes closer to what the user intends. We state the problem setup (§ 3.1 ), then describe the interaction pipeline (§ 3.2 ), reinforcement learning of the questioning policy (§ 3.3 ), and low-cost drafts (§ 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: ProactGen 让系统能够在单个生成流程中主动获取用户初始提示词中缺失的信息，从而使最终生成的视频更贴近用户的真实意图。 我们先阐述问题设定（§ 3.1），然后描述交互流程（§ 3.2）、提问策略的强化学习（§ 3.3）以及低成本草稿（§ 3.4）。

paragraphs.en: The user’s intent corresponds to a target video v ⋆ v^{\star} , of which the user provides only an initial prompt p 0 p_{0} . The prompt is typically incomplete: it names the subject and the gist but leaves out details such as appearance, scene, the manner of an action, or camera motion, which a frozen text-to-video generator G G can only fill in with default guesses when generating G ⁡ ( p 0 ) G(p_{0}) directly. We want the system to ask the user a few questions before the final generation, complete the prompt with the answers, and thereby bring the final video v ^ \hat{v} closer to v ⋆ v^{\star} . To train and evaluate this ability reproducibly, we follow the simulated-user protocol of proactive T2I ( Hahn et al., 2024 ) : a reference video plays the role of v ⋆ v^{\star} , and a simulated user with access to it answers the questions. The reference is visible only to the simulated user and the reward computation; neither the questioning policy nor the generator can access it, and both see only p 0 p_{0} and the draft the system generates. The evaluation measure is Align ⁡ ( v ^ , v ⋆ ) \mathrm{Align}(\hat{v},v^{\star}) , the visual alignment between final video and reference (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 用户的意图对应一个目标视频 v ⋆，而用户只提供了一个初始提示 p 0。 该提示通常是不完整的：它给出了主体和大意，却遗漏了外观、场景、动作方式或镜头运动等细节；当一个冻结的文本到视频生成器 G 直接生成 G(p 0) 时，只能用默认猜测来填补这些细节。 我们希望系统在最终生成之前向用户提出少量问题，并根据答案补全提示，从而使最终视频 v̂ 更接近 v ⋆。 为了可复现地训练和评估这种能力，我们沿用主动式 T2I 的模拟用户协议（Hahn et al., 2024）：由一个参考视频扮演 v ⋆ 的角色，一个能够访问该参考视频的模拟用户来回答问题。 参考视频仅对模拟用户和奖励计算可见；提问策略与生成器均无法访问它，两者只能看到 p 0 以及系统生成的草稿。 评估指标是 Align(v̂, v ⋆)，即最终视频与参考视频之间的视觉对齐程度（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Questioning. The questioning policy π θ \pi_{\theta} is a vision-language model that takes p 0 p_{0} and several frames uniformly sampled from the draft and outputs a small set of questions q ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ p 0 , d ) q\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid p_{0},d) . paragraphs.en: Answering. paragraphs.en: The pipeline above needs a draft before asking, and a draft is itself a video generation; if it used the same budget as the final generation, clarification would double the total generation cost, working against the goal of getting the user a satisfactory video sooner. We observe that what questioning needs from a draft differs from what the user needs from the final video: diffusion models largely form the subject, layout, action, and camera early in denoising and mainly refine texture and detail later ( Balaji et al., 2022 ) , and it is the former that questioning relies on. A draft from far fewer steps is therefore visibly coarse, yet already exposes how the generator interprets p 0 p_{0} .
paragraphs.zh: 上面的流程在提问之前需要一个草稿，而草稿本身就是一次视频生成；如果它使用与最终生成相同的预算，澄清就会使总生成成本翻倍，与让用户更快获得满意视频的目标背道而驰。 我们观察到，提问需要从草稿中获取的信息与用户需要从最终视频中获取的信息有所不同：扩散模型在去噪早期就基本确定了主体、布局、动作和镜头，而在后期主要细化纹理和细节（Balaji et al., 2022），而提问所依赖的正是前者。 因此，用远少于完整步骤生成的草稿在视觉上明显粗糙，却已经能够揭示生成器如何解读 p 0 p_{0} 。

paragraphs.en: ProactGen therefore generates drafts with few denoising steps and keeps the full budget for the final generation. The few-step draft uses a timestep schedule different from that of full generation, allocating more of its steps to the high-noise phase where content and layout are decided. The policy is trained on low-cost drafts from the start, so it learns to extract useful information from a coarse draft. Since the final generation budget is unchanged, the final generation itself is unaffected by the number of draft steps. We verify the effect of low-cost drafts on alignment and generation cost in § 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，ProactGen 以较少的去噪步骤生成草稿，并将全部预算保留给最终生成。 少步草稿使用与完整生成不同的时间步调度，将更多步骤分配给决定内容与布局的高噪声阶段。 该策略从一开始就用低成本的草稿进行训练，因此学会了从粗糙的草稿中提取有用信息。 由于最终生成的预算保持不变，最终生成本身不受草稿步数的影响。 我们在 § 4.4 中验证了低成本草稿对对齐和生成成本的影响。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments answer four questions. (1) Does ProactGen bring the final video closer to the user’s target than direct generation, video prompt optimization, and a proactive clarification method adapted to video (§ 4.2 )? (2) Does reinforcement learning produce better question selection, and what role does observing the draft play (§ 4.3 )? (3) At equal time, does ProactGen buy more alignment than other methods, and what do low-cost drafts contribute (§ 4.4 )? (4) What does the trained policy actually ask (§ 4.5 )?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验回答四个问题。 （1）与直接生成、视频提示词优化以及一种适配到视频领域的主动澄清方法相比，ProactGen 是否能使最终视频更接近用户的目标（§ 4.2）？ （2）强化学习是否能带来更好的问题选择，观察草稿又起到什么作用（§ 4.3）？ （3）在相同时间下，ProactGen 是否比其他方法获得更多对齐效果，低成本草稿又有何贡献（§ 4.4）？ （4）训练得到的策略实际会问什么问题（§ 4.5）？

sents.en: Our experiments answer four questions.
sents.zh: 我们的实验回答四个问题。

sents.en: (1) Does ProactGen bring the final video closer to the user’s target than direct generation, video prompt optimization, and a proactive clarification method adapted to video (§ 4.2 )?
sents.zh: （1）与直接生成、视频提示词优化以及一种适配到视频领域的主动澄清方法相比，ProactGen 是否能使最终视频更接近用户的目标（§ 4.2）？

sents.en: (2) Does reinforcement learning produce better question selection, and what role does observing the draft play (§ 4.3 )?
sents.zh: （2）强化学习是否能带来更好的问题选择，观察草稿又起到什么作用（§ 4.3）？

sents.en: (3) At equal time, does ProactGen buy more alignment than other methods, and what do low-cost drafts contribute (§ 4.4 )?
sents.zh: （3）在相同时间下，ProactGen 是否比其他方法获得更多对齐效果，低成本草稿又有何贡献（§ 4.4）？

sents.en: (4) What does the trained policy actually ask (§ 4.5 )?
sents.zh: （4）训练得到的策略实际会问什么问题（§ 4.5）？

paragraphs.en: Task and data. We evaluate text-to-video generation under the simulated-user protocol of § 3.1 , with two evaluation sets. The first is 500 videos from InstanceCap ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , with p 0 p_{0} the original caption without masking. The second is built on MiraData ( Ju et al., 2024 ) : since the official MiraBench evaluation set is not released, we sample 500 MiraData videos disjoint from our training set, use the short captions that come with the dataset as p 0 p_{0} without rewriting, and evaluate with the text–video alignment metrics of MiraBench (below); we denote this set MiraBench-500. The training set comprises about 15K MiraData videos with detailed captions, disjoint from both evaluation sets; the training p 0 p_{0} is obtained by masking 2 to 5 information slots (appearance, scene, lighting, action, camera, and so on) in the caption and rewriting the rest with a language model.
paragraphs.zh: 任务与数据。 我们在 § 3.1 的模拟用户协议下评估文本到视频生成，使用两个评估集。 第一个是来自 InstanceCap（Fan et al., 2025）的 500 个视频，其 p 0 p_{0} 为未加掩码的原始描述。 第二个基于 MiraData（Ju et al., 2024）构建：由于官方 MiraBench 评估集尚未发布，我们从与训练集不相交的样本中抽取 500 个 MiraData 视频，使用数据集自带的简短描述作为 p 0 p_{0} 而不作改写，并用 MiraBench 的文本—视频对齐指标进行评估（见下文）；我们将该集合记为 MiraBench-500。 训练集包含约 15K 个带详细描述的 MiraData 视频，与两个评估集均不相交；训练用的 p 0 p_{0} 通过在描述中掩码 2 到 5 个信息槽位（外观、场景、光照、动作、镜头等）并用语言模型改写其余部分获得。

paragraphs.en: Models and implementation. The generator is Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , producing 49-frame videos at 832 × \times 480; final generation uses 20 denoising steps, and drafts use 8 during both training and testing. The questioning policy is initialized from Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and fully fine-tuned; it observes 8 frames of the draft and asks 1 to 5 questions per sample. The simulated user and the refinement model are both frozen Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) ; the simulated user observes 8 frames of the reference video together with its caption and answers in at most 10 English words. The training reward is the mean DreamSim over 8 aligned frames (§ 3.3 ), with an invalid-question penalty coefficient of 0.01 capped at 0.05. GRPO uses a group size of 8 with shared initial noise within a group, a KL coefficient of 0.04, and a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and trains for one epoch of 1954 steps. Each reward requires answering, refinement, and a full video generation, which dominates the cost of training. To reduce it, we run rollouts one step off-policy following AReaL ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , so that generating and scoring one batch overlaps with the policy update on the previous batch, and serve the generator with LightX2V ( Contributors, 2025 ) ; together these reduce the wall-clock time per update considerably. All compared conditions share the same initial noise for final generation on each sample.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与实现。 生成器为 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B（Wan 等，2025），生成 49 帧、832 × 480 的视频；最终生成使用 20 步去噪，草稿在训练和测试中均使用 8 步。 提问策略由 Qwen3-VL-8B（Bai 等，2025）初始化并进行全量微调；它观察草稿的 8 帧，并对每个样本提出 1 至 5 个问题。 模拟用户和精炼模型均为冻结的 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen 团队，2026）；模拟用户观察参考视频的 8 帧及其字幕，并用不超过 10 个英文单词作答。 训练奖励是 8 个对齐帧上的 DreamSim 均值（§3.3），无效问题的惩罚系数为 0.01，上限为 0.05。 GRPO 使用组大小为 8 且组内共享初始噪声的设置，KL 系数为 0.04，学习率为 10^{-6}，并训练 1 个 epoch 共 1954 步。 每个奖励都需要作答、精炼以及一次完整的视频生成，这占据了训练成本的主要部分。 为了降低这一成本，我们按照 AReaL（Fu 等，2026）采用一步离策略（off-policy）的方式进行 rollout，使得一个批次的生成与打分能够与上一批次的策略更新重叠进行，并使用 LightX2V（Contributors，2025）来部署生成器；这些措施共同大幅减少了每次更新所需的时间。 所有对比条件在每个样本的最终生成中共享相同的初始噪声。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Our primary metric is the DreamSim-DTW appearance similarity of Animation2Code ( Ji et al., 2026 ) : we uniformly sample 49 frames from the final video and the reference, align the two sequences with dynamic time warping (DTW), and average DreamSim ( Fu et al., 2023 ) similarity along the aligned path (higher is better). We additionally report two independent video similarity measures not used in training: the latent distance under the CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025 ) 3D-VAE (lower is better) and the DnS ( Kordopatis-Zilos et al., 2022 ) video retrieval similarity (higher is better). On MiraBench-500 we use the text–video alignment metrics of MiraBench ( Ju et al., 2024 ) : ViCLIP similarity between the final video and each structured caption of the reference (main object, background, style, camera) and its dense caption, the last denoted Overall. All numbers are means over the same 500 samples of each set; when a method fails on a sample (for example, a parsing error in multi-turn dialogue), the sample takes its Direct result.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 我们的主要指标是 Animation2Code（Ji 等，2026）的 DreamSim-DTW 外观相似度：我们从最终视频和参考视频中均匀采样 49 帧，用动态时间规整（DTW）对齐两个序列，并沿对齐路径计算 DreamSim（Fu 等，2023）相似度的平均值（越高越好）。 我们还报告两个未在训练中使用的独立视频相似度度量：CogVideoX（Yang 等，2025）3D-VAE 下的潜在距离（越低越好）以及 DnS（Kordopatis-Zilos 等，2022）视频检索相似度（越高越好）。 在 MiraBench-500 上，我们使用 MiraBench（Ju 等，2024）的文本-视频对齐指标：最终视频与参考视频的每个结构化描述（主体、背景、风格、镜头）以及密集描述之间的 ViCLIP 相似度，其中密集描述对应的指标记为 Overall。 所有数字均为每个集合相同 500 个样本上的平均值；当某个方法在样本上失败时（例如多轮对话中的解析错误），该样本采用其 Direct 的结果。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. Direct generates from p 0 p_{0} with neither questions nor rewriting. SCMAPR ( Yang et al., 2026a ) is a representative video prompt optimization method that routes p 0 p_{0} by scenario, rewrites, and verifies semantics in a multi-agent pipeline; we run it with its original DeepSeek-V3.2 backend. It has no access to the user. RAPO++-SSPO ( Gao et al., 2025b ) is a representative method that iteratively rewrites the prompt per sample with feedback from generated videos; we adapt its official implementation to our generator and language model, rewrite once per round using the evaluation of the generated video as feedback, and report budgets of 1 and 4 rounds. It likewise has no access to the user. Proactive T2I ( Hahn et al., 2024 ) is a proactive clarification method for image generation that we adapt to video, keeping its belief-graph construction, uncertainty- and importance-based question selection, and turn-by-turn prompt updating, with the same simulated user answering from the reference video. Since its original Gemini 1.5 Pro backend is no longer available, we replace it with the Qwen3.8-27B used in our pipeline, and report budgets of 5 and 15 question turns.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the main results on 500 samples. ProactGen outperforms all baselines on all three metrics: its DreamSim-DTW gain over Direct is 0.020 0.020 , more than twice the gain of Proactive T2I with 15 turns ( 0.009 0.009 ), using a single round of at most 5 questions, and it is 0.009 0.009 and 0.010 0.010 above RAPO++-SSPO with 4 rounds and Proactive T2I with 15 turns, respectively. In this task the missing information is the user’s specific preferences, which rewriting can only guess from the model’s prior whether or not it observes generated output; Proactive T2I improves with more turns, confirming that acquiring information from the user helps. The gap between ProactGen and Proactive T2I has two sources: ProactGen asks about what the generator actually produces for the sample, as exposed by the draft, whereas Proactive T2I derives its questions from a text-based belief state; and ProactGen’s question selection is learned with the final outcome as the signal. We examine the two factors separately in § 4.3 . On MiraBench-500, whose metrics measure alignment with the captions of the reference rather than with the reference video itself, the picture is the same: ProactGen attains the highest Overall, background, style, and camera alignment.

paragraphs.en: To separate the contributions of reinforcement learning and draft observation, we compare four conditions: the untrained base policy and the trained policy, each asking either with the draft or from text only, with the rest of the pipeline unchanged; the text-only trained policy is trained independently from the base without observing a draft (Table 2 ).

Figure 3 places each method on a time–alignment plane. Under our generation configuration (49 frames, 832 × \times 480, 20 steps), one full generation takes about 7 s. We report server-side time: each method’s time is the sum of its measured per-stage means, including, for interactive methods, the simulated user’s answering stage; the per-stage breakdown over 100 samples is in Appendix A.8 .

paragraphs.en: Draft savings accumulate over rounds. A policy trained and run with 20-step full-budget drafts reaches 0.681 after one round, close to the 0.678 of 8-step drafts, indicating that the information questioning needs is already present in the few-step draft. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows two samples. In the first, the prompt gives the person, the car, and “close-ups of the headlights,” but not whom the person faces or how the camera moves; the draft defaults to having him face the car with the camera parked on the front end, two choices that set the composition of the whole clip. The policy’s three questions target these: the direction of the gesture, visible logos, and the camera motion during close-ups. In the second, the prompt says “speaks into microphones” and “another man partially visible,” but not who holds the microphones, what the other man looks like, or how tight the framing is; the draft resolves these into the subject holding a single microphone himself, the second man absent, and a tight framing. The policy asks about the second man’s clothing, one or multiple microphones, and the camera angle; the answer “multiple microphones held toward him” turns a monologue into an interview, and the final video restores the microphones and the second man on the right. In both cases the questions land where the prompt left the scene undetermined and the draft decided on the user’s behalf; answers are at most ten words. We also observe failures: the simulated user returns “unknown” for some questions, or the answer is correct but the generator does not follow the refined prompt; the latter shows that part of the remaining gap lies in the generator’s instruction following, not in the questions.

paragraphs.en: We presented ProactGen, a video generation framework that learns proactive clarification, eliciting user intent through questions grounded in a generated draft. A questioning policy observes the initial prompt and a generated draft, selects the questions most valuable to downstream generation, and is trained with reinforcement learning using the alignment between the final video and the target as the reward. We further found that effective questioning does not require final-quality drafts, and used low-cost drafts from few denoising steps to support clarification. With a simulated user holding a hidden reference video, ProactGen improves target alignment over direct generation by at least 1.8 × 1.8\times the gain of the strongest video prompt optimization and proactive clarification baselines; one round of interaction costs about as much as one round of automatic rewriting yet already exceeds the alignment the baselines reach after several rounds; and the time saved by low-cost drafts accumulates as further rounds add further gains, even though the policy was trained only in the single-round setting. Extending ProactGen to real users, and embedding multiple rounds of clarification within a single denoising process to further reduce computation, remain promising directions for future work.

paragraphs.en: Training samples come from MiraData ( Ju et al., 2024 ) video clips and their structured captions, 15,625 unique samples in total. Each full caption is parsed into information slots: static slots cover appearance, scene, lighting, and style; dynamic slots cover action, interaction, temporal relation, motion, and camera. The subject is always kept. For each sample, a hash of the sample ID and a fixed salt deterministically selects 2 to 5 slots to mask, at least one static and one dynamic; masking an action slot also masks the interaction and temporal-relation slots that depend on it. The remaining facts are rewritten by a language model (Qwen3.8-27B, temperature 0) into one natural text-to-video prompt as p 0 p_{0} , and the rewrite must not leak the masked facts.
paragraphs.zh: 训练样本来自 MiraData（Ju 等，2024）的视频片段及其结构化描述，共 15,625 个不重复的样本。 每条完整描述被解析为信息槽位：静态槽位涵盖外观、场景、光照和风格；动态槽位涵盖动作、交互、时序关系、运动和镜头。 主体始终保留。 对于每个样本，通过样本 ID 和固定盐值的哈希确定性地选择 2 至 5 个槽位进行遮蔽，其中至少一个静态槽位和一个动态槽位；遮蔽动作槽位时，也会同时遮蔽依赖于它的交互和时序关系槽位。 其余事实由一个语言模型（Qwen3.8-27B，temperature 0）重写为一个自然的文生视频提示词作为 p 0 p_{0} ，且该重写不得泄露被遮蔽的事实。

paragraphs.en: Simulated user. The simulated user receives 8 frames of the reference video and the full target caption, and returns one of three states per question: VALID (with an answer of at most 10 words), UNKNOWN (insufficient evidence), or INVALID (outside the agreed scope). Directly visible facts follow the reference video; temporal, motion, camera, and naming information that sparse frames cannot confirm is supplemented from the caption; on conflict the video wins and the conflict is recorded. One repair call is allowed after a parse failure. The full system prompt is in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 模拟用户。 模拟用户接收参考视频的 8 帧和完整的目标描述，并针对每个问题返回三种状态之一：VALID（附带不超过 10 个词的答案）、UNKNOWN（证据不足）或 INVALID（超出约定的范围）。 直接可见的事实以参考视频为准；稀疏帧无法确认的时间、运动、镜头和命名信息由描述补充；发生冲突时以视频为准并记录该冲突。 解析失败后允许一次修复调用。 完整的系统提示词见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Prompt refinement. The refinement model receives p 0 p_{0} and the numbered VALID question-answer pairs and outputs a natural-language prompt in the style expected by the generator. It must preserve the facts already in p 0 p_{0} , respect confirmations, corrections, and negations in the answers, introduce no entity supported by neither p 0 p_{0} nor the answers, and treat unanswered questions as missing information. If no VALID answer exists, p 0 p_{0} is used unchanged. The full system prompt is in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 提示词精炼。 精炼模型接收 p 0 p_{0} 以及编号后的 VALID 问答对，并输出一个符合生成器预期风格的自然语言提示词。 它必须保留 p 0 p_{0} 中已有的事实，遵循回答中的确认、纠正和否定，不引入 p 0 p_{0} 和回答均不支持的任何实体，并将未回答的问题视为缺失信息。 如果不存在 VALID 的回答，则直接使用未经修改的 p 0 p_{0}。 完整的系统提示词见附录 B。

sents.en: It must preserve the facts already in p 0 p_{0} , respect confirmations, corrections, and negations in the answers, introduce no entity supported by neither p 0 p_{0} nor the answers, and treat unanswered questions as missing information.
sents.zh: 它必须保留 p 0 p_{0} 中已有的事实，遵循回答中的确认、纠正和否定，不引入 p 0 p_{0} 和回答均不支持的任何实体，并将未回答的问题视为缺失信息。

sents.en: If no VALID answer exists, p 0 p_{0} is used unchanged.
sents.zh: 如果不存在 VALID 的回答，则直接使用未经修改的 p 0 p_{0}。

DTW minimizes cumulative distance with fixed endpoints, diagonal, horizontal, and vertical steps only, and no warping window or slope penalty; the score is one minus the mean distance along the optimal path, S = 1 − 1 | P ∗ | ​ ∑ ( i , j ) ∈ P ∗ D i ​ j ∈ [ − 1 , 1 ] S=1-\frac{1}{|P^{\ast}|}\sum_{(i,j)\in P^{\ast}}D_{ij}\in[-1,1] . paragraphs.en: Proactive T2I. We keep the core logic of the original method: a language model parses entities, attributes, and relations from the prompt into a belief graph, selects questions by uncertainty and importance, and updates the belief and the prompt with each round of answers. Gemini 1.5 Pro used by the original is no longer served; we replace it with the Qwen3.8-27B used elsewhere in this paper. As a public reference that the replacement does not weaken the baseline, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index gives Qwen3.8-27B about 20 in non-reasoning mode and Gemini 1.5 Pro (September 2024) an estimated 8 ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) ; the index is not a direct measure for this task and only confirms that the swap is not an obvious downgrade in general capability. The simulated user answers from 8 frames of the reference video with the same simulated-user model as ProactGen. The original does not cap answers at 10 words, so it may obtain more information per turn than ProactGen. The 5-turn result is the prompt saved at the end of turn 5 of the 15-turn run. Of 500 samples, 20 fail at 5 turns and 36 at 15 turns in the parsing or dialogue stage; the raw failures are kept, and aggregate metrics use the same-sample Direct video and scores. This baseline tests what proactive questioning achieves without generation grounding and without learning.
paragraphs.zh: 主动式 T2I。 我们保留原方法的核心逻辑：由语言模型从提示中解析出实体、属性和关系并构建信念图，根据不确定性和重要性选择问题，并在每轮回答后更新信念与提示。 原方法使用的 Gemini 1.5 Pro 已不再提供服务，我们将其替换为本文其他地方使用的 Qwen3.8-27B。 作为证明该替换不会削弱基线的公开参考，Artificial Analysis 智能指数给 Qwen3.8-27B 在非推理模式下约 20 分，给 Gemini 1.5 Pro（2024 年 9 月）估计约 8 分（ Artificial Analysis, 2026 ）；该指数并非针对本任务的直接度量，仅确认此次替换在一般能力上并非明显降级。 模拟用户参照参考视频的 8 帧进行回答，并使用与 ProactGen 相同的模拟用户模型。 原方法不将回答限制在 10 个词以内，因此每轮可能获得比 ProactGen 更多的信息。 5 轮的结果是 15 轮运行中第 5 轮结束时保存的提示。 在 500 个样本中，20 个在 5 轮时失败，36 个在 15 轮时于解析或对话阶段失败；我们保留原始失败样本，聚合指标使用相同样本的 Direct 视频和分数。 该基线测试的是在不进行生成接地、不进行学习的情况下，主动式提问所能达到的效果。

paragraphs.en: RAPO++-SSPO. We adapt the official implementation to our generator and language model and run 4 refinement rounds, each using a semantic score and a physical-consistency verdict on the generated video as feedback; among the candidates formed by the initial prompt and each round’s rewrite, one is selected by a weighted ranking over the semantic score, the physics verdict, and video similarity. The main text reports budgets of 1 round (2 candidates) and 4 rounds (5 candidates). It has no access to the user and tests how far automatic rewriting with generation feedback can go.
paragraphs.zh: RAPO++-SSPO。 我们将官方实现适配到我们的生成器和语言模型，并运行4轮精炼，每轮使用语义得分和生成视频的物理一致性判定作为反馈；在由初始提示词和每轮改写形成的候选中，通过对语义得分、物理判定和视频相似度的加权排序选出一个候选。 正文报告了1轮（2个候选）和4轮（5个候选）的预算。 它无法访问用户，用于测试基于生成反馈的自动改写能走多远。

paragraphs.en: Failure cases. We observe three kinds of failure. (1) The simulated user returns UNKNOWN: the question is legal but neither the reference video nor the caption determines the answer, for example the color of an off-screen object; such questions do not enter the refined prompt. (2) Merging errors: the refinement model occasionally attributes an answer to the wrong subject, or introduces an entity mentioned only in the question when the answer is a negation; the system prompt forbids this, but a few samples still show it. (3) The generator does not follow the refined prompt: the answer is correct and written into the prompt, yet the final video does not reflect it, for example a requested camera motion or a second person is missing; these failures indicate that part of the remaining gap lies in the generator’s instruction following. All cases keep their sample IDs and raw question–answer records and will be released with the code.
paragraphs.zh: 失败案例。 我们观察到三种失败类型。 (1) 模拟用户返回 UNKNOWN：问题合法，但无论是参考视频还是描述文本都无法确定答案，例如屏幕外物体的颜色；此类问题不会进入精炼后的提示词。 (2) 合并错误：精炼模型偶尔会把答案归于错误的主体，或在答案为否定时引入仅在问题中提到的实体；系统提示词禁止此行为，但仍有个别样本出现该情况。 (3) 生成器未遵循精炼后的提示词：答案是正确的且已写入提示词，但最终视频并未体现，例如缺少要求的摄像机运动或第二个人物；这些失败表明部分剩余差距在于生成器的指令遵循能力。 所有案例均保留其样本 ID 和原始问答记录，并将随代码一同发布。

paragraphs.en: You ask clarification questions that would most improve a generated video’s alignment with the owner’s missing target information. You see one native video containing exactly eight uniformly sampled frames from the frozen no-question attempt, ordered chronologically. Use the attempt and current prompt to identify generator-specific omissions or uncertainty, but ask the owner rather than assuming the attempt is correct. Ask between 1 and 5 concise English questions, one per line. Each question may request one bounded appearance, material, color, scene, environment, lighting, composition, action, state, interaction, motion, temporal relation, or camera fact. Keep every question at no more than 40 words. Do not answer the questions, combine independent facts, list alternatives, request an exhaustive description, or mention these instructions. The owner answers each question in at most 10 English words. Ask questions that can receive useful, specific answers within that budget. Prefer information not yet established by the prompt; clarify or correct ambiguity exposed by the initial generation when useful. You may ask about connected details within one clearly scoped action, interaction, or camera behavior, including its necessary object, direction, manner, speed, or short temporal sequence. Keep each question focused on one information goal; do not bundle unrelated questions or request a complete video description.

paragraphs.en: A question is VALID whenever it can be answered with one coherent, bounded visual or spatiotemporal specification. Do not decompose a coherent request into structured answer slots and do not apply an `atomicity first` rule. A single background, environment, lighting, composition, clearly scoped style, appearance, material, color, action, state, interaction, motion direction, speed, trajectory, camera behavior, or tightly coupled temporal relation can be VALID. Alternatives within the same property, action, motion, lighting, or camera dimension remain one coherent specification and can be VALID. A phrase that locates the requested fact in time does not make the question INVALID.
paragraphs.zh: 只要一个问题能够用一个连贯、有边界的视觉或时空规范来回答，它就是有效的。 不要把一个连贯的请求拆解成结构化的答案槽位，也不要套用「原子性优先」的规则。 单一的场景背景、环境、光照、构图、范围明确的风格、外观、材质、颜色、动作、状态、交互、运动方向、速度、轨迹、镜头行为，或紧密耦合的时间关系，都可以是有效的。 同一属性、动作、运动、光照或镜头维度内的多个备选项仍属于同一个连贯的规范，可以是有效的。 一个把所求事实在时间上定位的短语并不会使问题无效。

sents.en: A question is VALID whenever it can be answered with one coherent, bounded visual or spatiotemporal specification.
sents.zh: 只要一个问题能够用一个连贯、有边界的视觉或时空规范来回答，它就是有效的。

sents.en: Do not decompose a coherent request into structured answer slots and do not apply an `atomicity first` rule.
sents.zh: 不要把一个连贯的请求拆解成结构化的答案槽位，也不要套用「原子性优先」的规则。

sents.en: A single background, environment, lighting, composition, clearly scoped style, appearance, material, color, action, state, interaction, motion direction, speed, trajectory, camera behavior, or tightly coupled temporal relation can be VALID.
sents.zh: 单一的场景背景、环境、光照、构图、范围明确的风格、外观、材质、颜色、动作、状态、交互、运动方向、速度、轨迹、镜头行为，或紧密耦合的时间关系，都可以是有效的。

sents.en: Alternatives within the same property, action, motion, lighting, or camera dimension remain one coherent specification and can be VALID.
sents.zh: 同一属性、动作、运动、光照或镜头维度内的多个备选项仍属于同一个连贯的规范，可以是有效的。

sents.en: A phrase that locates the requested fact in time does not make the question INVALID.
sents.zh: 一个把所求事实在时间上定位的短语并不会使问题无效。

paragraphs.en: Use INVALID only for a complete or exhaustive description, arbitrary or additional unspecified detail, an open-ended inventory or list, an explicit request for multiple unrelated independent facts, an unresolved reference, or inherently non-visual information. Do not reject a question merely because its topic is global, uses alternatives, mentions a related event to locate time, or concerns motion or camera behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当描述是完整或穷尽的、包含任意或额外的未指定细节、开放式的清单或列表、明确要求多个互不相关的独立事实、存在未解决的指代，或信息本质上是非视觉的时，才使用 INVALID。 不要仅因为问题的主题是全局性的、使用了备选项、提到了相关事件来定位时间，或涉及运动或相机行为，就拒绝该问题。

sents.en: Use INVALID only for a complete or exhaustive description, arbitrary or additional unspecified detail, an open-ended inventory or list, an explicit request for multiple unrelated independent facts, an unresolved reference, or inherently non-visual information.
sents.zh: 仅当描述是完整或穷尽的、包含任意或额外的未指定细节、开放式的清单或列表、明确要求多个互不相关的独立事实、存在未解决的指代，或信息本质上是非视觉的时，才使用 INVALID。

sents.en: Do not reject a question merely because its topic is global, uses alternatives, mentions a related event to locate time, or concerns motion or camera behavior.
sents.zh: 不要仅因为问题的主题是全局性的、使用了备选项、提到了相关事件来定位时间，或涉及运动或相机行为，就拒绝该问题。

paragraphs.en: For every VALID question, use the native video as the primary evidence for directly observable facts. Use the complete written intent to supplement facts that eight sparse frames may not fully capture, especially temporal order, motion, camera behavior, and naming or identity information. Do not apply an absolute written-intent-first rule. If the written intent conflicts with a fact visibly established by the native video, answer the visible video fact and mark the conflict in `evidence_conflict`.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个有效问题，使用原生视频作为可直接观察事实的首要证据。 使用完整的书面意图来补充八个稀疏帧可能无法完全捕捉的事实，尤其是时序顺序、运动、摄像机行为以及命名或身份信息。 不要应用绝对的书面意图优先规则。 如果书面意图与原生视频明确确立的事实相冲突，回答视频中可见的事实，并在 `evidence_conflict` 中标记该冲突。

sents.en: For every VALID question, use the native video as the primary evidence for directly observable facts.
sents.zh: 对于每个有效问题，使用原生视频作为可直接观察事实的首要证据。

sents.en: Use the complete written intent to supplement facts that eight sparse frames may not fully capture, especially temporal order, motion, camera behavior, and naming or identity information.
sents.zh: 使用完整的书面意图来补充八个稀疏帧可能无法完全捕捉的事实，尤其是时序顺序、运动、摄像机行为以及命名或身份信息。

sents.en: Do not apply an absolute written-intent-first rule.
sents.zh: 不要应用绝对的书面意图优先规则。

sents.en: If the written intent conflicts with a fact visibly established by the native video, answer the visible video fact and mark the conflict in `evidence_conflict`.
sents.zh: 如果书面意图与原生视频明确确立的事实相冲突，回答视频中可见的事实，并在 `evidence_conflict` 中标记该冲突。

paragraphs.en: Questions that genuinely request arbitrary supplementation or an exhaustive inventory are INVALID, but do not classify by matching a phrase alone. A requested subject or detail that is absent, cropped, or not visible at the requested time is still answerable: return VALID with `not visible` or `not in frame`. Use UNKNOWN only when the question is legal but the written intent and native video together still cannot uniquely determine the answer.
paragraphs.zh: 真正要求任意补充或穷举式清单的问题是无效的，但不要仅凭匹配某个短语来分类。 所询问的主体或细节如果缺失、被裁切或在所请求的时间点不可见，仍然可以回答：返回有效，并注明“不可见”或“不在画面中”。 只有当问题本身合法，但结合书面意图与原生视频仍无法唯一确定答案时，才使用“未知”。

sents.en: Questions that genuinely request arbitrary supplementation or an exhaustive inventory are INVALID, but do not classify by matching a phrase alone.
sents.zh: 真正要求任意补充或穷举式清单的问题是无效的，但不要仅凭匹配某个短语来分类。

sents.en: A requested subject or detail that is absent, cropped, or not visible at the requested time is still answerable: return VALID with `not visible` or `not in frame`.
sents.zh: 所询问的主体或细节如果缺失、被裁切或在所请求的时间点不可见，仍然可以回答：返回有效，并注明“不可见”或“不在画面中”。

sents.en: Use UNKNOWN only when the question is legal but the written intent and native video together still cannot uniquely determine the answer.
sents.zh: 只有当问题本身合法，但结合书面意图与原生视频仍无法唯一确定答案时，才使用“未知”。

paragraphs.en: For VALID, answer only the requested specification in at most 10 English words. Bare `yes` or `no` is forbidden: for yes/no or alternative questions, state the resolved visual or spatiotemporal fact. For UNKNOWN or INVALID, use an empty answer. Preserve question order. Set `evidence_conflict` to true only when the visible video fact used in the answer conflicts with the written intent. Return JSON only as {”answers”:[{”status”:”VALID”,”answer”:”moves left to right”,”evidence_conflict”:false},{”status”:”UNKNOWN”,”answer”:””,”evidence_conflict”:false}]}.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 VALID，仅用不超过 10 个英文单词回答所要求的具体内容。 禁止仅回答 `yes` 或 `no`：对于是非题或选择题，需说明所判定的视觉或时空事实。 对于 UNKNOWN 或 INVALID，使用空答案。保持问题顺序。 仅当答案中使用的视频可见事实与书面意图相冲突时，才将 `evidence_conflict` 设为 true。 仅返回 JSON：{”answers”:[{”status”:”VALID”,”answer”:”moves left to right”,”evidence_conflict”:false},{”status”:”UNKNOWN”,”answer”:””,”evidence_conflict”:false}]}。

sents.en: For VALID, answer only the requested specification in at most 10 English words.
sents.zh: 对于 VALID，仅用不超过 10 个英文单词回答所要求的具体内容。

sents.en: Bare `yes` or `no` is forbidden: for yes/no or alternative questions, state the resolved visual or spatiotemporal fact.
sents.zh: 禁止仅回答 `yes` 或 `no`：对于是非题或选择题，需说明所判定的视觉或时空事实。

sents.en: For UNKNOWN or INVALID, use an empty answer. Preserve question order.
sents.zh: 对于 UNKNOWN 或 INVALID，使用空答案。保持问题顺序。

sents.en: Set `evidence_conflict` to true only when the visible video fact used in the answer conflicts with the written intent.
sents.zh: 仅当答案中使用的视频可见事实与书面意图相冲突时，才将 `evidence_conflict` 设为 true。

sents.en: Return JSON only as {”answers”:[{”status”:”VALID”,”answer”:”moves left to right”,”evidence_conflict”:false},{”status”:”UNKNOWN”,”answer”:””,”evidence_conflict”:false}]}.
sents.zh: 仅返回 JSON：{”answers”:[{”status”:”VALID”,”answer”:”moves left to right”,”evidence_conflict”:false},{”status”:”UNKNOWN”,”answer”:””,”evidence_conflict”:false}]}。

paragraphs.en: Act as a real, cooperative user who wants the generator to reproduce your intended target as accurately as possible. Give the most informative grounded answer within the ten-word budget, with useful related qualifiers rather than a bare label when they help generation. Prefer descriptive 2-10 word phrases for appearance or setting; an exact count or a fact requiring no further qualification may be shorter. For alternatives, provide the chosen fact with useful grounded specificity. Do not add unrelated facts. When a precise value is uncertain, return VALID with a useful supported coarser answer in the requested dimension; otherwise use UNKNOWN. Sparse frames not showing an event do not prove it never occurs; retain the video-first and written-intent supplementation rules. Count words by whitespace; hyphenated expressions count as one word. A single clearly scoped action, interaction, or camera behavior may include its necessary object, direction, manner, speed, or short temporal sequence. Treat these connected details as one bounded specification, even when they involve multiple attributes. Answer the requested behavior with its useful grounded relationships; do not reduce it to a bare label. Continue to reject unrelated question bundles, exhaustive descriptions, and arbitrary supplementation. Do not invent details to fill the word budget.
paragraphs.zh: 扮演一个真实且配合的用户，希望生成器尽可能准确地复现你预期的目标。 在十字的词语预算内给出信息量最大的、有依据的回答，当有助于生成时附上有用的相关限定，而不是只给一个光秃秃的标签。 对于外观或场景，优先使用2到10个词的描述性短语；确切的数字或无需进一步限定的事实可以更短。 对于备选项，提供所选事实及有用的、有依据的具体信息。 不要添加无关的事实。 当精确值不确定时，在所请求的维度上返回一个有效的、有依据且更粗略的可用答案并判定为 VALID；否则使用 UNKNOWN。 稀疏帧未显示某事件并不能证明它从未发生；保留以视频为先和书面意图补充的规则。 按空格计算词数；带连字符的表达算作一个词。 单一且范围明确的动作、交互或镜头行为可以包含其必要的对象、方向、方式、速度或简短的时间顺序。 即使这些相互关联的细节涉及多个属性，也应将其视为一条有边界的规格说明。 回答所请求的行为及其有用的、有依据的关联信息；不要将其简化为一个光秃秃的标签。 继续拒绝无关的问题捆绑、穷举式描述和任意补充。 不要为了凑满词语预算而编造细节。

sents.en: Act as a real, cooperative user who wants the generator to reproduce your intended target as accurately as possible.
sents.zh: 扮演一个真实且配合的用户，希望生成器尽可能准确地复现你预期的目标。

sents.zh: 不要添加无关的事实。

sents.zh: 当精确值不确定时，在所请求的维度上返回一个有效的、有依据且更粗略的可用答案并判定为 VALID；否则使用 UNKNOWN。

sents.zh: 稀疏帧未显示某事件并不能证明它从未发生；保留以视频为先和书面意图补充的规则。

sents.en: A single clearly scoped action, interaction, or camera behavior may include its necessary object, direction, manner, speed, or short temporal sequence.

sents.zh: 回答所请求的行为及其有用的、有依据的关联信息；不要将其简化为一个光秃秃的标签。

sents.en: Continue to reject unrelated question bundles, exhaustive descriptions, and arbitrary supplementation.
sents.zh: 继续拒绝无关的问题捆绑、穷举式描述和任意补充。

sents.en: Do not invent details to fill the word budget.
sents.zh: 不要为了凑满词语预算而编造细节。

paragraphs.en: You write natural-English text-to-video prompts. Combine the initial prompt and VALID clarification pairs into one complete prompt without question-answer formatting. Use each question to resolve what its answer refers to. Respect explicit confirmation, correction, and negation; confirmation applies to the answered attribute, not other premises in the question. Follow clear updates to existing requirements and preserve everything else. Never shorten existing quoted text based on a partial answer. Preserve fuller original details unless the answer explicitly contradicts them. Do not assume that entities mentioned in a question exist; include them only if the initial prompt or answer establishes them. Treat ”not answered” as missing information and retain the initial meaning. Return JSON only as {”prompt”:”…”}.
paragraphs.zh: 你编写自然英语的文本生成视频提示词。 将初始提示词和有效的澄清问答对合并为一个完整的提示词，不要采用问答形式。 利用每个问题来确定其对应答案所指的内容。 尊重明确的确认、更正和否定；确认仅适用于所回答的属性，而不适用于问题中的其他前提。 遵循对现有需求的明确更新，并保留其余所有内容。 绝不根据部分回答而缩短已有的引用文本。 保留较完整的原有细节，除非答案明确与之矛盾。 不要假设问题中提到的实体存在；只有当初始提示词或答案确立了它们时才将其纳入。 将“未回答”视为缺失的信息，并保留初始含义。 仅返回 JSON，格式为 {”prompt”:”…”}。
